split_rule: Sort each task by SHA-256 of canonical source row. Development used positions 0:20. These untouched panels use positions 20:60, 60:100, and 100:140, respectively. Panels are disjoint fixed blocks, not stochastic generation seeds.
memory_selection: Unchanged after development: retain the most recent K query-relevant causal facts, where K grows 1, 2, 3 with model scale. Neither question parsing nor retrieval accesses the target answer.
schedule_design_invariant: The 1/2/3 fact-slot scale schedule and all prompts, decoding, models, and task balance are identical to frozen development commit d53b21f; no confirmation prediction was accessed before this config was committed.
primary_metric: Exact extracted-location accuracy; ASCENT-minus-Foundation paired gain, task-balanced over official BABILong QA1/QA2/QA3 4K.
confirmation_gate: Across the three fixed disjoint panels, every endpoint mean gain, both adjacent mean gain increments, and their panel-level or row-cluster-robust 95% lower bounds must be positive. Report regressions and task-stratified results. Failure stops claim expansion.
interpretation: Untouched structurally different compositional-memory confirmation for scale-expanding ASCENT on the official SmolLM2 family. FPVM excluded.
